title: Romantic Journey Through Japan | Temples, Towers, and Traditions
highlights: Enjoy a romantic journey through Japan, where ancient traditions, vibrant cities, and breathtaking scenery come together for an unforgettable experience.
Stroll through the timeless charm of Nakamise-dori Street, where rows of vibrant stalls offer traditional snacks, handcrafted souvenirs, and a taste of old Tokyo.
Indulge in a shopping spree at Gotemba Premium Outlets, where luxury brands meet scenic beauty with Mt. Fuji as your stunning backdrop.
Glide over the volcanic valley of Ōwakudani on the Hakone Ropeway, where steaming vents, black eggs, and surreal landscapes await.
Relive your favorite movie moments at Universal Studios Japan, where thrilling rides and immersive worlds turn every corner into a cinematic adventure.
overview:
About the Tour:
Embark on a romantic journey through Japan, where timeless tradition meets modern wonder. Begin in Tokyo, exploring iconic sights like Meiji Shrine, Sensoji Temple, and the soaring Tokyo Skytree, with leisure time for shopping in Ginza or strolling through Shibuya Crossing. Relive childhood magic at Tokyo Disneyland, then visit Mt. Fuji’s 5th Station, cruise Lake Ashi, and shop at Gotemba Outlets. Continue to Osaka via bullet train, where you’ll enjoy leisure time to explore the city on your own. While in Osaka, visit Osaka Castle, and dive into cinematic worlds at Universal Studios Japan. This tour blends rich history, vibrant city life, and playful adventure, making it perfect for couples seeking memorable moments together.

know_before_you_go: ID proof is mandatory for each guest at the time of booking and also upon arrival. PAN card will not be considered a valid address proof.
All international participants will have to share passport and visa details on arrival.
Learn basic Japanese phrases like "Konnichiwa" (hello) and "Arigatou" (thank you).
﻿﻿Remove your shoes when entering someone's house, a traditional house, or a temple in Japan.
Always remember not to leave chopsticks upright in a bowl of rice, as it's considered disrespectful.
Using your phone for calls during a train or bus journey is considered inappropriate etiquette in Japan.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Tokyo | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Japan! Upon arrival at Narita International Airport, enjoy a scenic journey to your hotel. After check-in, spend the rest of the day at leisure, where you can explore Ginza, Tokyo’s upscale shopping district known for luxury boutiques and sleek architecture. Also, you can catch a live performance at the Samurai Theater or go for a peaceful stroll through Yoyogi Park. Get a chance to dive into Tokyo’s vibrant energy at the iconic Shibuya Crossing, where the city truly comes alive.

items.title: Check-in at Shinjuku Washington Hotel Annex

days.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, head to Shinjuku Love Statue & board the bus for Tokyo city tour. Along the way, enjoy views of landmarks like Godzilla Head in Kabukicho & historic National Diet Building. Also, marvel at tech-savvy Akihabara street & Kappabashi Dougu Street, famed for its kitchenware shops. Don't miss Meiji Jingu Shrine, known for its calm ambience & Sensoji Temple, renowned for its Kaminarimon Gate. Afterwards, get dropped off at Shinjuku Station's West Exit. From there, head to the hotel on your own.

items.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour - Departure from Shinjuku LOVE Statue (With Lunch)

days.title: Day Trip to Disneyland
days.desc: In the morning, get driven to Tokyo Disneyland to indulge in a fun-filled day at one of Asia’s most iconic theme parks. Once there, step into the nostalgic charm of World Bazaar, designed like a 20th-century American town. Also, explore themed lands such as Adventureland, Tomorrowland, and Fantasyland, home to beloved classics like Peter Pan’s Flight and It’s a Small World. Enjoy thrilling rides, vibrant parades and character meet-and-greets that bring Disney magic to life at every turn.

days.title: Trip to Mt. Fuji 5th Station, Hakone & Gotemba Outlets
days.desc: Today, head to the Shinjuku Center Building and get driven for an exciting trip. Begin with a visit to Mt. Fuji’s 5th Station, offering panoramic views of the surrounding mountains. Continue to Gotemba Premium Outlets, offering top brands with Mt. Fuji as a majestic backdrop and soar above the dramatic landscapes of Ōwakudani Volcanic Valley on the Hakone Ropeway, famous for its steaming vents. Later, enjoy a pirate ship cruise on Lake Ashi before getting driven to JR Shinjuku Station West Exit.

items.title: Trip to Mt Fuji 5th Station, Hakone & Gotemba Outlets

days.title: Transfer to Osaka | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Check out from your hotel and head to Shinjuku Station to board the iconic bullet train to Osaka. Upon arrival, make your way to the hotel and check in. The rest of the day is yours to explore at leisure, where you can relax or set out to discover Osaka’s vibrant attractions. You can stroll across the lively Ebisu Bridge or admire the digital art at teamLab Botanical Garden. Also, you can enjoy panoramic views from the retro Tsutenkaku Tower or soak in the peaceful atmosphere of Hozenji Temple.

items.title: Transfer in Bullet Train (Shinkansen)
items.desc: 1 X Bullet Train (Shinkansen) will be Provided

items.title: Check-in at APA Hotel Shin Osaka Ekimae

days.title: Osaka Walking Tour
days.desc: Head to the meeting point—Exit 2 of Tanimachi 4-Chome Station for the Osaka walking tour. Start with a visit to Osaka Castle, renowned for its striking architecture. Continue to explore Koreatown, where you can enjoy its street culture. Then head to Tennoji Ward, home to Abeno Harukas, Japan’s tallest non-tower building. Experience the charm of Shinsekai, famous for its bright neon signs. Also, make your way to Dotonbori, where you can indulge in street food like takoyaki and kushikatsu.

days.title: Day Trip to Universal Studios
days.desc: Today, get driven to Universal Studios Japan for a full day of movie-inspired thrills at one of Asia’s premier entertainment parks. With your express pass, skip the queues and dive straight into blockbuster attractions themed around Harry Potter, Jurassic Park, Minions, and Spider-Man. Also, wander through the Wizarding World of Harry Potter, or ride the high-speed Flying Dinosaur ride. Don’t miss the chance to enjoy dazzling parades and live shows that bring cinematic magic to life.

days.title: Leisure Day in Osaka
days.desc: Take the day to explore Osaka at your own pace. You can visit Namba Yasaka Shrine, known for its unique lion-shaped stage that is believed to bring good fortune and success. Alternatively, you can explore Den Den Town, offering everything from gadgets & anime merchandise to vintage video games, an ideal spot for tech lovers & pop culture enthusiasts alike. If you wish, you can also visit Floating Garden Observatory, offering panoramic views of the city, especially stunning at sunset.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, check out from your hotel in Osaka and board your transfer to the Kansai International Airport. Upon arrival, take your flight home, marking the end to your romantic getaway to Japan!
